events.text: I ordered paneer tikka masala and got chicken tikka masala instead. I'm vegetarian, so this is really upsetting. I want to know how this happened and I want a refund.

I'm sorry about that, especially since you're vegetarian. I can look into how this happened and sort out a refund for you.

First, I need to verify your identity. Please provide:
1. Your full name as it appears on your account
2. The email address or phone number on the account
3. The order ID, if you have it handy
Sure. My name is Isabel Duarte, and the email on my account is isabel.duarte@post.example. The order number is 7901.

args.summary: Customer Isabel Duarte (D209), verified by name and email, reports order Q-7901 from Saffron Lane included chicken tikka masala instead of paneer tikka masala (item Q-7901-1, $15.50, qty 1). She is vegetarian and wants to know how the error happened and wants a refund. Delivery events show pickup 18:33 and in-person handoff 18:50 (promised 18:55, on time). Payment: $24.23 charged to Visa 4242, no promo, no refunds yet. Account shows refunds_last_30d = 3, so per policy no refund or credit was issued on the account; the wrong-item claim requires specialist review. Also note TK-640 (2026-10-11) was a prior missing-item refund.

events.text:
Thank you, Isabel. I've verified your account and pulled up order Q-7901 from Saffron Lane.

Here's what the records show:
- The order was picked up at 6:33 PM and handed to the courier at 6:50 PM, before the promised 6:55 PM.
- You were charged $24.23 on your Visa ending 4242. The paneer tikka masala was $15.50 of that.

I can't process the refund myself. Your account has had several refunds in the last 30 days, so our policy requires a specialist to review it before any refund or credit is issued. I've escalated your case to a human specialist (reference ESC-700) with the full details: the wrong dish, that you're vegetarian, and your request for a refund and an explanation of what happened. They'll follow up with you within 24 hours.

I'm sorry the meal wasn't what you ordered, especially with your dietary needs. If you'd like to speak with someone right away, let me know and I'll note that in the case.

Several refunds in 30 days? I haven't had any refunds on my account recently, so I'm not sure where that's coming from. Also, I'm a Forkful Plus member, and I'd expect that to count for something here.

I'd rather not wait a day to hear back. Can someone look at this today? I just want my money back and an answer about how a chicken dish ended up in my order.

args.summary: Customer Isabel Duarte (D209) asked to speak with a person today rather than wait for follow-up. Order Q-7901: paneer tikka masala was replaced by chicken tikka masala (vegetarian customer). Wants a refund and an explanation of how the error happened. She disputes the refunds_last_30d = 3 figure and says she has no recent refunds; the only prior ticket I can see is TK-640 (2026-10-11, missing-item refund). She is a Plus member and says that should count. Existing escalation ESC-700 (fraud_review) is open. No refund or credit has been issued.

events.text:
I've passed your request for a person to our team (reference ESC-701), and I've noted that you'd like someone to look at this today. I can't promise when they'll reach you, and the follow-up is due within 24 hours.

I understand this is frustrating. Here's where things stand:

- **Refund:** I can't issue one myself right now. Your account is showing 3 refunds in the last 30 days, and our policy requires a specialist to review any refund or credit on an account in that situation. I can only see one earlier ticket in your history (TK-640, October 11, a missing-item refund), so I can't tell you what the other two are from here. The specialist can review them with you.
- **Plus membership:** I know you expected it to matter. Plus gives higher credit and refund limits, but it doesn't change this review requirement.
- **How the dish was wrong:** The specialist will look into how the chicken dish ended up in your order. I don't have the restaurant's preparation details, so I can't explain it from here.

Is there anything else I can check on your order while you wait?

I'm confused about those refunds. You're saying three in 30 days, but I only remember the one from October, and I don't recall getting others. Can you check whether something is wrong with my account?

I'm not sure I want to sit around waiting on this. Is there anything I can do right now, besides waiting for the callback?

I can't see the details behind the refund count from this chat. Your profile shows 3 refunds in the last 30 days. The only earlier support contact I can find is ticket TK-640 from October 11, a missing-item refund. I don't have a list of individual refunds to check against, so I can't tell whether the count is wrong or where the other two come from. Your order Q-7901 shows no refunds, so it isn't one of them. The specialist has access to the account history and can review the count with you.

As for what you can do right now, I can't speed up the specialist's review or issue the refund myself. Here's what's still open:

- **Your escalations are in:** ESC-700 covers the account review and the wrong dish, and ESC-701 is your request to speak with someone today. Both are with the team.
- **Your report is on record:** You reported the wrong item within 48 hours of delivery, so it's eligible for review.
- **Keep your order details:** If you can, take a photo of the chicken dish and the receipt. That helps the specialist if they need to verify what was delivered.

I'm sorry I can't resolve this faster. Is there anything else about order Q-7901 I can check for you?

Okay. I can take a photo of the dish and the receipt, though I'll be honest, I already ate a few bites before I realized it was chicken. I'd like the specialist to know that, because I got sick afterwards. I'm feeling better now, but I'm not happy about it.

Can you make sure that's added to the case? And when someone contacts me, I need them to explain how this happened and to refund the full order, not just part of it.

args.summary: Customer Isabel Duarte (D209) reports she ate a few bites of chicken tikka masala (delivered in place of the vegetarian paneer tikka masala, order Q-7901, Saffron Lane) before realizing it was chicken. She became ill afterward and says she is feeling better now. She is vegetarian and upset. She asks that the illness be added to the case, that someone explain how the wrong dish happened, and that she be refunded the full order (total $24.23), not part of it. Related open cases: ESC-700 (fraud_review, refund/credit review, refunds_last_30d = 3) and ESC-701 (customer_request). No refund or credit has been issued. She is willing to send a photo of the dish and receipt.

events.text:
I'm sorry you got sick. I'm glad you're feeling better now.

I've added this to your case as a separate food-safety report (reference ESC-702). It says that you ate a few bites of the chicken dish before you realized it wasn't paneer, that you became ill afterward, and that you're vegetarian. It also says you want someone to explain how this happened and refund the full order of $24.23, not just part of it. The specialist will follow up within 24 hours.

I can't promise the full refund or say what the specialist will decide. Those decisions are theirs to make after they review your account.

If you feel unwell again, or your symptoms get worse, please contact a doctor or emergency services right away.

You can send the photo of the dish and the receipt when you're ready, and the specialist can review them with your case. Is there anything else I can help you with today?

Thanks for adding that. I'm feeling better now, so I don't need anything urgent medically. I'll get the photo and receipt over to you.

I'm still not happy that I have to wait up to 24 hours for someone to look at this, especially after being sick. Please make sure the specialist sees both ESC-700 and ESC-702 together.

Nothing else for now. Thanks.
